snippet.title: BONEBUILDER Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
BONEBUILDER is an action roguelike where you collect bones and equipment from defeated enemies to create the most powerful skeleton. Your ultimate goal is to save the land you once lived in from the evil necromancer!

Play the DEMO on steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5174470/BONEBUILDER_Demo/

Wishlist the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3584060/BONEBUILDER/

Early Acess begins Q1 2027!
